en:
## New Features

- IM Gateway: connect narrators to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Lark, and Webhook platforms with per-session narrator mapping and built-in commands (`/new`, `/stop`, `/status`, `/help`)
- Bash tool runtime timeout adjustment: click the elapsed/timeout indicator on a running tool card to change the timeout on the fly
- Subagent status bar: SubagentCard now shows real-time todo progress, retry countdown, and waiting state inline
- ShareFile copy link button: quickly copy the download URL from the ShareFile tool card

## Improvements

- Settings page restructured from single-page accordion to sidebar navigation with 13 sub-routes for faster loading
- WebSocket catch-up race condition fix: delayed subscription ensures history messages arrive before real-time broadcasts
- Migrated to Vite 8 (Rolldown) with plugin-react v6 (Oxc), upgraded 23 dependencies including React 19.2, Hono 4.12, Drizzle 0.45, TypeScript 5.9
- Fixed 80 test failures via global settings snapshot/restore preload and updated assertions
- API error handling now preserves raw response text when the server returns non-JSON responses

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed permission button pulse animation color mismatch
- Fixed fullscreen toggle state sync (restored `fullscreenchange` listener)
- Fixed duplicate save buttons on providers settings page
- Fixed MCP crash when `mcpServers` config is corrupted
- Aligned Bash timeout minimum clamp value with validator (1000ms)
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- IM Gateway 系统：支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack、飞书、Webhook 五种平台接入叙述者，每个 IM 会话自动创建独立 narrator，内置 `/new`、`/stop`、`/status`、`/help` 命令
- Bash 工具运行时超时调整：点击运行中工具卡片的耗时/超时指示器，可实时修改超时时间
- 子代理状态栏：SubagentCard 实时显示 todo 进度、重试倒计时和等待状态
- ShareFile 复制链接：工具卡片新增一键复制下载链接按钮

## 改进

- 设置页从单页手风琴重构为侧边栏导航 + 13 个子路由，提升加载性能
- WebSocket catch-up 竞态修复：延迟订阅机制确保历史消息先于实时广播到达
- 迁移至 Vite 8（Rolldown）+ plugin-react v6（Oxc），升级 23 个依赖（React 19.2、Hono 4.12、Drizzle 0.45、TypeScript 5.9 等）
- 修复 80 个测试失败（全局 settings 快照/恢复预加载 + 更新断言）
- API 错误处理改进：服务端返回非 JSON 响应时保留原始响应文本

## 修复

- 修复权限按钮脉冲动画颜色不匹配
- 修复全屏切换状态同步（恢复 `fullscreenchange` 事件监听）
- 修复 providers 设置页与 layout 层保存按钮重叠
- 修复 MCP 配置损坏时的崩溃问题
- Bash 超时最小值与 validator 对齐（1000ms）
